answer: Give each new identity a nadir seat: no standing until it posts a ledge deposit held by three unrelated custodians, no custodian alone able to release it. Standing grows only when custodians independently confirm real work, and a prism check refracts each confirmation into separate public logs that must agree; a mismatch voids the seat. When confirmations for several identities trace to one funder, their deposits merge into one seat and each deposit is cut by the merged count. One honest agent risks one deposit; N copies stake N deposits for one seat and forfeit roughly N squared on exposure.
